content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IISc Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: IISc Program Assistant Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available – 5 for the Program Assistant post.

content_sections.heading: IISc Program Assistant Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: M.Com./ MBA/ MCA from a recognized University with at least 02 years of post-qualification experience in managing and coordinating projects/programmes, including liaison and coordination with various stakeholders and agencies.

content_sections.heading: IISc Program Assistant Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years Age relaxation as per GoI norms (if applicable) will be extended.

content_sections.heading: IISc Program Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IISc Program Assistant Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IISc to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IISc Program Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IISc Program Assistant recruitment is 14-08-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Program Assistant post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is M.Com./MBA/MCA from a recognized University with at least 02 years of post-qualification experience in managing and coordinating projects/programmes.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Program Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Program Assistant post is 35 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Program Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Program Assistant post in the Indian Institute of Science.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Program Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 34,000/- + HRA Per Month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website or the provided link.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the IISc Program Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Program Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Program Assistant post will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity at the Indian Institute of Science.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Indian Institute of Science located?
faq.answer: The Indian Institute of Science (IISc) is located in Bangalore, Karnataka.
